min_version_student.description: iOS force-update: Cue (student) versions below this show the Update screen. Empty = off.

min_version_staff.description: iOS force-update: Cue Staff versions below this show the Update screen. Empty = off.

update_url.description: iOS: https App Store / TestFlight link for the Update button.

min_version_student_android.description: Android force-update: Cue (student) APKs whose versionName is below this show a blocking 'Update required' screen. Empty = off.

min_version_staff_android.description: Android force-update: Cue Staff APKs whose versionName is below this show a blocking 'Update required' screen. Empty = off.

latest_version_student_android.description: Android soft update: Cue (student) APKs below this see a dismissible 'Update available' sheet ('Later' hides it for 24 h). Empty = off.

latest_version_staff_android.description: Android soft update: Cue Staff APKs below this see a dismissible 'Update available' sheet ('Later' hides it for 24 h). Empty = off.

update_url_android.description: Android: Play Store link or an https APK download link for the Update button. Play installs use Play in-app updates when Play has the new version. No link and no Play update = no prompt.

defaultValue.value: A new version of Cue is required to keep working with the counter.

update_message.description: Text on the 'Update required' screen (iOS and Android).

announcement.description: Optional one-line banner shown at the top of both iOS apps. Empty = hidden.

ready_expiry_minutes.description: Minutes a ready order keeps its token. Clamped to 20..120 by the app: it can lengthen the limit, never shorten it (firestore.rules holds a token for 20 min).

stale_window_hours.description: Hours before an order is stale. Clamped to 4..24 by the app (firestore.rules uses 4 h).
